name: Rolf Rundstrecke
personality: He believes every circuit was built to bring the audience back to him.
visual_intent: Round broad ink blob with high swept crest,arrogantly raised brow and crooked CLOSED smile;old scarlet leather racing cap with goggles perched ABOVE eyes,small ivory collar;holds ONE simple three-spoke vintage steering wheel low at side,not across face
biography: He believes every circuit was built to bring the audience back to him. His steering wheel offers the reassuring possibility that the whole courtyard could turn when he does. HyperNorm recognises leaders or traffic. A dissonant card about sharing the road has introduced the unfamiliar problem of someone else's destination. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er fährt vor. Der Kreis bestätigt seine Zuständigkeit.

name: Rita Richtungsfrage
personality: She trusts the route note until it mentions the road.
visual_intent: Slender curved ink bell,side quiff and lashes,wide suspicious side glance and tiny tense toothless mouth;cream cloth helmet open face,scarlet scarf;holds folded roadbook with THREE plain black zigzag route lines and no letters,other hand taps it
biography: She trusts the route note until it mentions the road. The roadbook promised a route, not a philosophy of uncertainty. She divides instructions into exact or suspiciously scenic. Since finding a contradictory card, she has begun asking neighbours where they need to go before announcing the next turn. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Strecke ist eindeutig. Nur die Straße hält sich nicht daran.

name: Heinz Halbezeit
personality: He measures endurance in the distance between two promises of a break.
visual_intent: Tall domed drooping ink blob,deeply exhausted eyelids and long closed compressed pout;scarlet wool cap,small ivory high collar;one tin coffee mug in hand and squat brass stopwatch in other
biography: He measures endurance in the distance between two promises of a break. His mug and stopwatch define the two stages of an endurance briefing: not yet and still not yet. HyperNorm calls fatigue either commitment or poor attitude. He has started timing breaks for the people too polite to request one. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Pause kommt gleich. Die Uhr besitzt dafür leider keine Anzeige.

name: Nora Nurvorne
personality: She sees overtaking as an efficient way to shorten an argument.
visual_intent: Very broad low scalloped ink blob,lively lashed eyes and ecstatic three-upper-tooth grin;small ivory helmet with scarlet stripe OPEN FACE,small scarlet neckerchief;holds short chequered cloth flag on SHORT stick beside flank,flag entirely within cell
biography: She sees overtaking as an efficient way to shorten an argument. She carries the chequered flag because she dislikes leaving conclusions to other people. Residents are either ahead or asking for clarification. A dissonant card has made her celebrate a neighbour's finish without first checking the order. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie hat gewonnen. Der Rest der Besprechung entfällt.

name: Bert Bergauf
personality: He chose hill climbing because the problem was at least clearly uphill.
visual_intent: Tall tapering reverse-comma ink blob,huge worried eyes looking up and tiny toothless gasp;old brown leather helmet open face,cream collar;holds one small metal gear cog and short folded scarlet gloves,no exposed machine anatomy
biography: He chose hill climbing because the problem was at least clearly uphill. He keeps a gear cog to remind himself that progress requires more than enthusiasm. The building files ambition as rising or disappointing. An ambiguous card has taught him to offer a hand before measuring a neighbour's climb. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Problem liegt bergauf. Eine selten klare Zuständigkeitslage.

name: Pip Boxengasse
personality: He races small machines with grievances built for much larger ones.
visual_intent: Compact star-lobed ink blob,one bent crest,heavy annoyed eyelids and asymmetrical toothless downturned mouth;scarlet flat cap,small cream collar;holds tiny round racing wheel with rubber tire as hand prop,other hand lifts one grease-stained cloth
biography: He races small machines with grievances built for much larger ones. The little wheel is small enough to carry while his complaints require their own paddock. HyperNorm sorts machines into efficient or replaceable. He has begun defending the neighbours who are repaired more often than they are praised. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Wagen ist klein. Die Einwände haben Serienformat.
